item.title: Shooter killed ex-wife and a son in Rhode Island ice rink attack, police say
item.description: PAWTUCKET, R.I. (AP) — The person who opened fire Monday during a youth hockey game at a Rhode Island ice rink was specifically targeting family members, killing an ex-wife and son as many fans dived for cover while a handful rushed the shooter to stop the attack, authorities said. item.title: Historic Morgan County Rosenwald schoolhouse burns down
item.description: The Somerville community suffered a heavy loss Thursday. A historic schoolhouse for Black children burned down, reducing nearly 100 years of history, culture, and memories to ash.

item.title: City of Decatur officials vote to reconstruct Point Mallard Golf Course Rates
item.description: City of Decatur Officials have voted to reconstruct the golf rates at Point Mallard Golf Course. The decision, made during a recent City Council meeting, updates fees for daily rounds, season passes, and special events in an effort to make the course more accessible while covering operational costs.

item.title: Cullman police officer arrested on domestic violence charge
item.description: A Cullman Police Department officer was placed on administrative leave after being arrested on a domestic violence charge Monday evening.

item.title: Sheriff's Office investigating, student removed after threat at Wilson Elementary School
item.description: The Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office says it is investigating after a threat was made at Wilson Elementary School on Tuesday.

item.title: Alabama lawmaker introduces bill to criminalize 'interference with a first responder'
item.description: An Alabama lawmaker has introduced new legislation that would create criminal penalties for people who interfere with police officers, firefighters, or other emergency personnel while they are on duty.
